dct_description_sm:
see also Lake Babine Nation Tsak 9 Reserve, 1899_2024
(https://doi.org/10.5683/SP3/L62FO4)

Georeferenced map of Lake Babine Nation Ne-Tsaw-Greece 10 reserve just north of Smithers Landing clipped from original Plan No. 3 of the Hagwilget Indian Reserves, Cassiar District. (https://doi.org/10.58066/662g-j470).  Land cover and features include hay land, soil and types of trees.
